req.text: Footsteps of one person in soft cloth shoes walking slowly on dry packed earth, six even steps with slight grit, close, dry, no music.
One person in cloth shoes running on a dry packed-earth road, eight quick steps with dust and grit, close, dry, no music.
Footsteps of one person in soft cloth shoes walking on old stone paving slabs, six even steps, close, dry, no music.
Footsteps of one person in cloth shoes walking on an old timber plank bridge, six steps, hollow wooden knock with a slight creak of planks, close, dry, no music.
Footsteps of one person in cloth shoes walking on worn bricks covered with sand and grit, six steps, gritty scuffs, close, dry, no music.
Footsteps of one person walking slowly through short dry grass and weeds, six soft swishing steps, close, dry, no music.
Two people in loose cotton robes brushing shoulders as they pass in a crowd: soft cloth rustles and a muffled bump, four separate short brushes, close, dry, no speech, no music.
Walking through long hanging willow branches: thin leafy strands swishing and sliding over cloth clothing, close, dry, no music.
A donkey snorting and shaking its head, its rope halter and wooden saddle creaking, close, outdoors, dry.
A horse snorting softly and stamping one hoof on packed earth, bridle jingling lightly, close, outdoors, dry.
A horse whinnying once, outdoors, mid distance, dry recording.
A calm ox lowing once, deep and long, outdoors, mid distance, dry recording.
Close-up of a standing ox breathing heavily through its nose and chewing cud slowly, outdoors, dry.
Several pigs grunting and snuffling while rooting in dirt, outdoors, close, dry.
A medium village dog barking three times at a passer-by, outdoors, mid distance, dry.
A crow cawing a few times from a tall tree, outdoors, mid distance, dry.
A small bird taking off from a tree branch, quick flutter of wings and a short chirp, close, outdoors, dry.
Sparrows chirping and chattering in a leafy tree, close, outdoors, daytime, no music.
A donkey walking at a slow steady pace on a packed earth road, small hooves clopping, a loose harness creaking, close, dry, no music.
A horse walking slowly on a packed earth road carrying a rider, steady hoof beats, saddle leather creaking, close, dry, no music.
A camel walking slowly on packed earth, soft heavy padded footsteps and a load of bales creaking on its back, close, dry, no music.
A standing donkey shifting its weight, rope harness and wooden pack frame creaking with a small metal ring clinking, close, dry.
A heavy wooden wheelbarrow with a single wooden wheel rolling slowly on a dirt road, the wooden axle squeaking and the load creaking, close, dry, no music.
A heavy wooden cart rolling slowly across a timber plank bridge, wheels thumping over each plank, hollow wooden rumble, close, dry, no music.
A wooden sedan chair carried on two long bamboo poles by bearers walking, the poles and the chair creaking rhythmically with each step, close, dry, no speech, no music.
A heavy grain sack dropped onto a wooden cart bed, a dull thud and grain shifting inside, close, dry.
Two heavy woven bamboo baskets set down on the ground off a shoulder pole, wicker creak and a soft thud, close, dry.
A string of old copper coins with square holes jingling, then a few coins dropped one by one into a wooden tray, close, dry, no music.
A soft calligraphy brush writing quickly on paper, then the brush tapped on an ink stone, quiet, close, dry, no music.
A large wooden frame scale creaking as a heavy cloth bale is hung on it with ropes, the beam swinging and settling, close, dry.
Ceramic bowls and small cups clinking on a wooden table in a tavern, a bowl set down, gentle, close, dry, no speech, no music.
Liquid poured from a narrow ceramic jar into a ceramic bowl, short gurgling pour, close, dry.
Dough frying in hot oil in an iron pan at a street stall, steady sizzling and bubbling, close, dry, no speech, no music.
A bamboo steamer lid lifted off with a puff of hissing steam, close, dry.
A long cloth shop banner hanging from a wooden pole flapping and snapping in a gusty wind, close, outdoors, no music.
Wooden shop shutter boards being lifted out of their grooves one by one and stacked against a wall, knocking wood, close, dry, no speech.
A small outdoor crowd of men bursting into hearty laughter together and then murmuring, no intelligible words, mid distance, no music.
A small outdoor crowd of men gasping in surprise together, then a short excited murmur, no intelligible words, mid distance, no music.
A straight razor stropped quickly back and forth on a leather strap, six strokes, close, dry.
One single heavy stroke on a large barrel drum on a city gate tower, deep boom with a long natural decay, heard outdoors from the street below, no other sounds.
A night watchman striking a hollow wooden clapper block twice, sharp wooden knocks echoing in an empty street at night, mid distance, no speech, no music.
One strike of a large bronze temple bell with a wooden beam, deep warm tone with a very long shimmering decay, outdoors, mid distance, no other sounds.
At dawn a temple servant walks along an empty street beating a small iron plate with a stick in a slow steady rhythm, getting nearer then passing, distant roosters, no speech, no music.
A rooster crowing once in the distance at dawn, outdoors, quiet village.
Gentle water lapping and gurgling against old wooden posts under a bridge, calm moat, close, steady, no music, no speech.
Frogs croaking in a reedy pond on a warm night, several frogs, mid distance, no music, no speech, no engines.
Field crickets chirping close by in grass on a calm night, steady, no music, no speech, no engines.
Evening in an old town street outside busy taverns: distant laughter and indistinct talk from inside, bowls clinking, a few unhurried footsteps, a quiet breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.

Daytime on a wooden bridge over a calm moat outside a town gate: water lapping softly at the posts, footsteps and hooves crossing the planks now and then, distant murmur of people, a light breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.
A quiet temple courtyard by day: wind in old trees, sparrows, a faint distant bell hum, gravel underfoot far away. No music, no speech, no engines.
A single gust of wind rising and falling through willow trees, leaves rustling then settling, outdoors, no music.
Close-miked: a silk hand scroll on a wooden roller unrolled briskly across a wooden table, a clear rustle of paper and silk and the roller knocking softly, dry.
Four separate light but clear taps of a small wooden stick on a sheet of thick paper, crisp papery ticks with short gaps, close-miked, dry.

Ambience of a busy open-air street market in an ancient town, daytime: indistinct murmur of many people talking at a distance, footsteps on packed earth, a wooden cart creaking slowly past, a donkey's hooves, occasional distant calls of street vendors. No music, no modern vehicles, no engines, no intelligible words.

Inside a long brick-vaulted city gate tunnel: echoing footsteps and slow hooves on packed earth, the soft padding of a camel, muffled street noise from both open ends, strong reverberation. No music, no speech, no engines.

Countryside dirt road lined with old willow trees on a spring morning: wind rustling through willow leaves, songbirds chirping, a distant rooster, a faint cart creaking far away. No music, no speech, no engines, no traffic.
Night in an ancient town in late summer: crickets and frogs chirping, a dog barking far away, a light wind, very quiet empty streets. No music, no speech, no engines.

A large Chinese barrel drum on a city gate tower struck slowly with heavy wooden beaters at dusk: deep booming hits with a long decay, heard from the street below at a distance, outdoors. No music, no other instruments.

A heavy wooden ox cart rolling slowly on a dirt road: the wooden axle creaking rhythmically, wheels crunching on gravel, a small iron bell hanging from the cart clinking with each jolt, slow ox hoof steps. No music, no speech.
A single donkey braying loudly, outdoors, close, dry recording.
A Bactrian camel grumbling and groaning low, close, outdoors, dry recording.
Close-up foley of a straight razor shaving stubble on a man's chin: slow scraping strokes, then the blade wiped on a cloth. Quiet, dry, no music.
A butcher chopping meat on a thick wooden block with a heavy cleaver: several solid thuds, outdoors, dry foley. No music.
A porter walking with a bamboo shoulder pole carrying two heavy baskets: the bamboo pole creaking rhythmically with each step, baskets swaying, footsteps on dirt. Close, dry, no music, no speech.
Close-miked: a strong wooden bow drawn slowly, the string and bow limbs creaking under tension, then released with a loud resonant twang, no arrow impact, dry.
A wandering monk walking down a street clapping two wooden boards together in a slow steady rhythm, outdoors, mid distance. No music, no speech.
A short leather whip cracked twice over a draft animal, two sharp snaps with a gap, outdoors, close, dry.
